line_move_from_open.note: first logged Pinnacle number to the last snapshot 3h+ before kickoff, move >= 1 point, follow the move at the post-move number. Open = first number we logged, not the true open.

reasons: mean closing-line value is not positive
mean closing-line value is not positive

cfb_open_edge.note: this season, model 5+ point edge vs the first spread, graded vs the open. No stored price, so the only test is win rate against the usual -110 break-even (52.38%, an assumption) plus stored CLV in points.

historical_backtest.caveat: 2022-2025 combined; the model was tuned on 2022-2023, so the 2022-2023 share of this record is in-sample and cannot be split out from the stored totals.

reasons: win rate not significantly above break-even (z 0.75)
the open is the number books post with small limits, so it is not reliably bettable
data/nflverse_injuries.json is a single current snapshot (status and designation only). With no history of when a status changed, an injury signal cannot be placed before a line move or a result.

polymarket_cheaper_than_pinnacle.note: ML only. Polymarket volume-weighted price on a side, trades 3h to 24h before kickoff (3+ trades), at least 2 points under the Pinnacle fair probability from the last snapshot at or before the last such trade. ROI uses that stored exchange price before fees.
reasons: does not beat the logged fair probability
